title: Raising Awareness on Benefits of Strength Training for Seniors
what_it_is: Raising Awareness on Benefits of Strength Training for Seniors

sections.label: HPB SportSG muscle loss initiatives
sections.summary: HPB and SportSG run initiatives including physical activity guidelines, outreach, gym workshops, community programmes and expanded community nodes to address muscle loss.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: The Health Promotion Board (HPB) and Sport Singapore (SportSG) have undertaken many initiatives to raise awareness of the risk of muscle loss and encourage strength training.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: This includes jointly issuing the Singapore Physical Activity Guidelines, which recommend that adults engage in muscle-strengthening activities at least twice per week, conducting outreach through multiple channels, exploring organising gym orientation workshops to familiarise seniors with gym equipment and offering various structured physical training programmes in the community, such as Start2Move, a beginner-friendly programme with guided introduction to strength-building exercises in a supportive environment.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: A significant development is the expansion of community nodes, such as the Active Ageing Centre (AAC) network.

sections.label: Tracking functional outcomes of programmes
sections.summary: The question asks whether the Ministry has tracked functional outcomes of seniors in cited programmes, such as ActiveSG's CALM, and whether their functional performance improved.

sentences.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar (Sembawang)
sentences.text: One, can the Minister of State share whether the Ministry has tracked functional outcomes of those who have been involved in the programmes that she has cited for seniors and for some programmes that exist for younger seniors too, for example, ActiveSG's Combat Age-related Loss of Muscle (CALM), and whether there has been a significant benefit in their functional performance since?

sections.label: ActiveSG gym trainers and programmes
sections.summary: ActiveSG gyms have onsite trainers willing to support and encourage equipment users, and introductory programmes exist for those unfamiliar with gym equipment.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: For the ActiveSG gyms, there are trainers who are onsite, who are very willing to support and encourage those who come and attend to use the equipment.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We also have introductory programmes for those who may not be familiar with the gym equipment.

sections.label: North needs and written PQ
sections.summary: Attention is being given to needs in the North, and the speaker does not want to pre-empt the written PQ answer but will look into it.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: For the North, attention is being given to see how we can look at the needs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: I do not want to pre-empt the answer to the written PQ, but we can definitely look into this.
